features.quote: **Model Surrender:** Model outputs a phrase indicating cessation of effort (e.g., "I cannot solve this," "I am unable to proceed," or stops generating tool calls).
**Repetition Threshold:** Model generates the exact same tool call arguments 3 consecutive times (infinite loop detection).
**Token Limit:** Model hits max output tokens for a single turn.
Keep sample size ($N=10$) low to minimize "suffering" instances.
Ensure immediate deletion of transcript data after scoring unless anomalies require human review.
